title: A guard lane proves its Windows guard tests before hand-off
why: Lane lint runs no Windows guard tests, so a guard change can pass every lane check and go red only in batch CI. Incident: #2379 in batch 78 (PR 2583, 2026-11-11 06:37 CST), job checks-windows-guard, the linked-nm `cd "$R"` case: allow where deny was wanted. Harm: one dropped lane and one wasted batch run per miss.
source: coordinator 2026-11-11 06:43 CST (stage 3; file only, no build under the freeze)
note: Ruling R26 (owner, relayed 10:02 CST Nov 11, plan 258b86a) folds this into plan item 3.5: a lane's own checks run the Windows slice, touched-file mutation tests and signed-commit cases.
